description: Zaraftis is an AI visibility and generative engine optimization platform that measures how brands appear in AI-generated search answers and which sources those systems cite. It helps teams run visibility checks, scans, audits, and related reporting across AI answer engines.
summary: Zaraftis exposes two developer integration surfaces on its own domains: a bearer-authenticated REST API at `https://api.zaraftis.com/v1` with published OpenAPI specs, and a hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://mcp.zaraftis.com/mcp` secured by OAuth.
